rejected_alternatives.reason: Continuing to Summit risks rejection at receipt: the arrival shelf-life margin is within the model's error band.
Re-routing to Harbor Foodservice preserves less value and the case is not urgent enough to give up the tier-A line.

recommendation.trade_off: Inspect at Central Valley DC costs a 4 h delay and the inspection fee, but resolves the conflicting certificate before committing a tier-A delivery.
recommendation.would_change_if: Inspection showed less than 10.5 days remaining, or the Harbor window closed before inspection.
recommendation.deviation_reason: The top risk-adjusted option (continue) relies on a certificate the probe contradicts.

invalid.why: the embedded recommendation must itself be valid
